subject.title: fix: preserve OpenAI Responses message boundaries

question: Should Bedrock Mantle's rotating-item exception be accepted as provider-name and URL policy in the generic Responses layer, or must it be supplied through the provider-owned stream compatibility boundary?
rationale: Repository policy assigns provider-specific stream behavior to provider hooks, while the latest patch preserves a shipped compatibility path by hard-coding that provider in generic code; accepting that tradeoff requires owner intent.

options.title: Use a provider-owned compatibility fact
options.body: Have the Bedrock provider normalize or declare the rotating-item behavior while the generic consumers remain lineage-only.

options.title: Accept the generic exception
options.body: Explicitly accept the provider-ID and URL coupling plus the residual false-positive collapse risk, with focused compatibility proof.

recommendation.title: Use a provider-owned compatibility fact
recommendation.body: Have the Bedrock provider normalize or declare the rotating-item behavior while the generic consumers remain lineage-only.

likelyOwner.reason: The choice affects the core/provider ownership boundary and the shipped compatibility behavior introduced by merge commit 9fbc8a74.
